description: This file defines the interface `ModuleConfigurationDao` which provides methods for accessing module configuration data in the SalesManager e-commerce system. It extends a generic DAO interface and declares methods to retrieve module configurations by some criteria.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationDao
classes.description: An interface for data access operations related to module configurations, extending generic DAO functionality.

methods.name: getModulesConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IntegrationModule objects based on the module name or identifier.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a single IntegrationModule by its module code.
